items.exampleEn: The plan got the approval of everyone.
items.exampleZh: 這個計畫得到了所有人的同意。

items.exampleEn: The team is unlikely to win this year.
items.exampleZh: 這支隊伍今年不太可能贏。

items.exampleEn: The cat stared at its reflection in the lake.
items.exampleZh: 貓盯著自己在湖面上的倒影。

items.exampleEn: I can't give you a guarantee that I will win.
items.exampleZh: 我無法向你保證我會贏。

items.exampleEn: She has little awareness of how loud her voice is.
items.exampleZh: 她幾乎沒意識到自己的聲音有多大。

items.exampleEn: I gained some insight into how a newspaper is made.
items.exampleZh: 我對報紙是怎麼做出來的有了一些深入的了解。

items.exampleEn: Do you have any proof that he took the money?
items.exampleZh: 你有任何證據證明他拿了錢嗎？

items.exampleEn: Even their mom can't see any distinction between the twins.
items.exampleZh: 連媽媽都看不出那對雙胞胎有什麼區別。

items.sentenceEn: It's unlikely that he will come today.

items.audioEn: Keep your receipt. It's your proof that you bought the phone here.
items.audioZh: 留好你的收據，那是你在這裡買手機的證明。
options: You can use it to win a prize next week.
It proves where you bought it.

items.sentenceEn: The manager gave her approval for the plan.
Traveling gives you insight into other cultures.
items.sentenceZh: 旅行讓你深入了解其他文化。

items.stemEn: Is there any ____ that this old map is real?
items.stemZh: 有任何證據證明這張舊地圖是真的嗎？

items.stemEn: Children under sixteen need their parents' ____ to join the club.
items.stemZh: 十六歲以下的孩子需要家長同意才能加入社團。

items.passageEn: Our class wanted to raise awareness of plastic waste at school. First, we needed the headteacher's approval. She liked our idea, but she wanted proof that students really cared. So we tried to get three hundred students to sign their names in one week. It seemed unlikely at first, but we did it! We then made posters that showed the distinction between things you can recycle and things you can't. There's no guarantee that everyone will change, but the results were spectacular: the amount of plastic in our trash fell by half. Many students told us the posters gave them a new insight. At the end, each of us wrote a short reflection on what we had learned.
items.passageZh: 我們班想提高全校對塑膠垃圾的意識。首先，我們需要校長的同意。她喜歡我們的點子，但想要證據證明學生真的在乎。所以我們試著在一週內讓三百名學生簽名。起初這看起來不太可能，但我們做到了！接著我們做了海報，說明可回收和不可回收物品之間的區別。不能保證每個人都會改變，但成果非常驚人：我們垃圾裡的塑膠量減少了一半。許多同學告訴我們，這些海報讓他們有了新的認識。最後，我們每個人都寫了一篇簡短的反思，談談自己學到了什麼。

options: 全班同學寫的一篇報告
一份詳細的活動花費清單
學校決定以後不再賣任何飲料
垃圾裡的塑膠量減少了一半

items.promptZh: 老闆對新人和老員工一視同仁，從不做區別。
referenceEn: The boss makes no distinction between new and long-time staff.
Our boss never makes a distinction between new staff and experienced staff.
rubricZh: 用 make a distinction between 表示「區別對待」（例如 makes no distinction between…）
「新人和老員工」可寫，例如 new and long-time staff、new staff and experienced staff 等

items.promptZh: 這麼晚了，餐廳不太可能還開著。
referenceEn: It's so late that the restaurant is unlikely to be open.
It is very late, so it is unlikely that the restaurant is still open.
rubricZh: 用 unlikely 表示「不太可能的」（例如 is unlikely to be open、It is unlikely that… 等）
